sentences.text: Ivan Lendl -LRB- -LSB- ˈɪvan ˈlɛndl̩ -RSB- ; born March 7 , 1960 -RRB- is a former world No. 1 professional tennis player and is currently coaching current world No. 1 Andy Murray , alongside Jamie Delgado .	Andy Murray	Andy Murray	world No. 1	List of ATP number 1 ranked players	Jamie Delgado	Jamie Delgado
Originally from Czechoslovakia , he became a United States citizen in 1992 .	Czechoslovakia	Czechoslovakia
He was one of the game 's most dominant players in the 1980s and remained a top competitor into the early 1990s .
He has been described as one of the greatest tennis players of all time .
Lendl 's game relied particularly on strength and heavy topspin from the baseline and helped usher in the modern era of `` power tennis '' .
Lendl captured eight Grand Slam singles titles .	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)

He competed in 19 Grand Slam singles finals , a record surpassed by Roger Federer in 2009 , Rafael Nadal in 2014 and Novak Djokovic in 2016 .	2016	Tennis at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Men's singles	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)	Roger Federer	Roger Federer	Rafael Nadal	Rafael Nadal	Novak Djokovic	Novak Djokovic

He reached at least one Grand Slam final for 11 consecutive years , a record shared with Pete Sampras , with the male primacy of eight consecutive finals in a Grand Slam tournament -LRB- a record shared with Bill Tilden at the US Open -RRB- .	US	US	Grand Slam	Grand Slam (tennis)	Pete Sampras	Pete Sampras	Bill Tilden	Bill Tilden
Before the formation of the ATP , Lendl reached a record 12 year-end championships -LRB- equalled by John McEnroe -RRB- .	ATP	Association of Tennis Professionals	John McEnroe	John McEnroe
He won two WCT Finals titles and five Masters Grand Prix titles , with the record of nine consecutive finals .	WCT Finals	WCT Finals	Masters Grand Prix	Masters Cup
